<thought>From the spectrum we see a series of peaks spaced by ~1.003 Da with intensities decreasing roughly 100 → 8 → 0.5 → 0.02 → 0.0006 → 0.00001. This pattern matches the isotopic distribution of carbon (12C/13C) in a molecule containing several carbons, and no other element shows a distinctive pattern (e.g., Cl/Br would give a 2 Da spaced doublet, S would give a much smaller M+1). Therefore carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified from the observed isotopic pattern.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
